question:
Select the option that represents the letters that, when sequentially placed from left to right in the blanks, will complete the letter series.

s _ t r m _ _ _ h _ _ m m k _ h t _ _ m k

options.text: h m k s t r s m r
h m k s r t s m m
h k m s t r s m m
h m k s t r s r m

solution:

3) h k m s t r s m m → s __h__ t r m __k__ __m__ - __s__ h __t__ __r__ m m k - __s__ h t __m__ __m__ m k

4) h m k s t r s r m → s __h__ t r m __m__ __k__ - __s__ h __t__ __r__ m m k - __s__ h t __r__ __m__ m k
